Re: Your Dispute of Account ACC-897135

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account listed above. We understand that you have disputed the account as already paid. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Florida state law.

We confirm that the account is currently listed on our records with a balance of 6176.5. The original creditor for this account is Horizon Card Co. We also note that the charge-off date for this account was January 9, 2022, and the last payment date was January 29, 2022.

As per your request, we will provide validation information for this account, as required by 12 CFR 1006.34(b)(5). We will send you a validation notice within the next 5 days, as specified by the FDCPA. This notice will include the name of the creditor, the amount of the debt, and a statement that unless the consumer disputes the validity of the debt within 30 days, we will assume the debt is valid.

Please note that we will not take any action to collect the debt until we have sent you the validation notice and you have had an opportunity to dispute the debt. You have the right to dispute the debt and request a copy of the validation notice.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,
